claims.subject: Pavlov Rachov 2013 electric component data
claims.object: motor and inverter datasheets (conservative motor values; Castle Creations inverter) and battery datasheets plus [18,19]
claims.statement: Pavlov Rachov 2013 takes brushless-dc motor power density and efficiency from datasheets and calls them conservative, takes inverter properties from Castle Creations data, and bases Li-Po, Li-ion and Li-S battery figures on [18,19] and Thunder Power and Sion Power datasheets.
qualifiers: cell versus pack basis of battery values is not stated; the cited Thunder Power sheet is a five-cell (5S) pack
claims.quote: The motor power density and efficiency adopted here, as determined from datasheets

claims.subject: Pavlov Rachov 2013 pump and turbopump densities
claims.object: Titan II turbopump: 18 kW/kg turbopump on axis power; 22 kW/kg electric-pump pump extrapolated
claims.statement: For the turbopump system Pavlov Rachov 2013 refers to the Titan II first stage (turbine efficiency 56%, pump 68%, 18 kW/kg on axis power); for the electric-pump system it keeps 68% pump efficiency and extrapolates 22 kW/kg pump power density from the Titan turbopump data.
claims.quote: extrapolated from the Titan turbopump data

claims.subject: battery mass safety factor
claims.object: 1.2, to let batteries run somewhat underrated and to allow redundancy for partial failure
claims.statement: A safety factor of 1.2 is adopted for the battery mass so the batteries operate somewhat underrated (preventing overheating and possible failure) and to make room for redundancy in case of partial failure.
claims.quote: A safety factor of 1.2 is adopted for the battery mass
